definitions.full: H5620. sar סַר adjective stubborn, resentful, sullen, implacable ; — וְזָעֵף סַר 1Kin 20:43 ; 21:4 ; feminine סָרָ֫ה רוּחֲךָ מַהזֶּֿה 21:5 why then is thy spirit sullen ? possibly also plural construct סוֺרְרִים סָרֵי Jer 6:28 revolters ( stubborn ones ) among, etc. (see above and סור Qal near the end).

occurrences.englishText: The king of Israel went to his house sullen and angry, and came to Samaria.

Ahab came into his house sullen and angry because of the word which Naboth the Jezreelite had spoken to him; for he had said, “I will not give you the inheritance of my fathers.” He laid himself down on his bed, and turned away his face, and would eat no bread.
But Jezebel his wife came to him, and said to him, “Why is your spirit so sad, that you eat no bread?”
